overview: Finalize the simulation loop by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing the tick-based physics solver for zero-allocation stability, and compressing the storyteller event log into a bit-packed format for rapid replay.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Hasher
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::span for input data. Implement FNV-1a 64-bit hash in constexpr. No dynamic allocation. Cache last hash in a static thread_local variable for O(1) comparison. Handle endianness explicitly via std::endian::native.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Hash is stable across 1000 runs. 0 heap allocations. <10ns per hash operation.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instant save/load verification, preventing 'corrupt save' errors.

tasks.title: Optimize Tick-Based Collision Solver with SIMD
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::array<CollisionPair, 1024> for static pool. Implement 4-wide SIMD intersection tests using <immintrin.h>. Unroll loops for 4-element batches. No virtual functions in hot path.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 10,000 collisions resolved in <1ms. No cache misses in hot loop.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smoother frame rates during large-scale colony events.

tasks.title: Bit-Packed Event Log Compression
tasks.architectural_spec: Define enum class EventType : uint8_t. Pack timestamp (32-bit) and type (8-bit) into 64-bit uint. Use std::bit_cast for serialization. Decompress via bitwise shifts.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Log size reduced by 75%. Decompression speed > 1GB/s.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster UI rendering for event history.
